Subject: POC Kickoff Recap – Acme Corp

Hi Jane / John,

Thanks again for a great kickoff this morning. Quick recap to make sure we're aligned and to capture next steps. If I missed anything, please flag.

Pain points you called out:
- Customer support agents waste ~30% of time on internal knowledge search and triage (slow KB retrieval + inconsistent summaries).
- Latency and token cost with current in-house model when running at agent scale.
- Need for strong data controls (KMS + access logs) for PII-sensitive support transcripts.

Primary goals for the POC (success metrics):
- Retrieval + generation pipeline that reduces average handle time (AHT) by 15% (baseline TBD).
- Response quality: >90% acceptable answers in a 200-sample eval (we'll run blinded evals).
- Production feasibility: sustain 200 concurrent agents with median latency < 300ms per token and predictable cost within X budget (we'll provide cost estimates after model selection).

Scope / approach:
- Scope: Support agent assist (first-phase). We'll test retrieval-augmented generation + prompt templates.
- Prompt set / evals: Redwood will provide an initial 200-prompt eval set based on the call transcript + sample tickets you shared. Acme will review and add edge-case prompts.
- Metrics: AHT delta, evaluation accept rate, median token latency, per-100k token cost.

Owners & timeline:
- Acme: Jane Doe (POC lead), John Smith (SRE contact)
- Redwood: Marissa Cole (AM), Aditya Rao (solutions / infra integration), Rishi Malhotra (dedicated runtime lead)
- Timeline: 6-week POC. Week 0–1: infra & access, Week 2–4: evals + tuning, Week 5: integration test, Week 6: results & next steps.

Access & setup items (needed from Acme):
1) Service account + S3 read access to sample support transcripts (we need a small sample dataset to build prompt set).
2) VPN or temporary VPC peering details and a contact for network firewall rules (John?).
3) SOC2 questionnaire – we will share our security packet; please identify the team/person who will handle questions.

Attachments: acme_poc-scope-and-metrics.xlsx (xlsx), acme_access_instructions.txt (txt)

Immediate next steps:
- Acme: share service account + sample data by Mon 7/3.
- Redwood: send PoC MOP + infra checklist by EOD Fri (attached).
- Schedule weekly sync (proposed: Tuesdays 10am PT).

Thanks — looking forward to getting started.

Best,
Marissa
